content_html:
November 23, 2026, 3:48pm 1

Roto version 0.14.0 is now available on crates.io! This is mostly a bugfix release and most users should be able to upgrade without any problems. The only breaking change is around List::contains and List::index when they are used from Rust.

For this release, I’d like to thank sha90w and @algernon in particular for both reporting and fixing many issues!

As always you can find the release in the following places:

  • crates.io
  • Codeberg

You can find the full list of changes below!

Language

Added

  • Added the List.clear and List.remove methods. (#500)

Bug fixes

  • Report an error instead of crashing when trying to assign to a constant. Thanks, @sha90wsha90w! (#477)
  • The lexer now properly handles multi-byte characters in all places. Th@sha90wnks, @sha90w! (#482)
  • Fix parsing of char and String literals at the end of input. This issue did not affect Roto in its current state, but enables future wo@sha90wk. Thanks, @sha90w! (#488)
  • Fix the module name of the pkg.roto file of a dependency, which interfered with the pkg.roto of the main package. (#485)
  • Fix panics in cases where an error needs to display a hint in another file than where the error @sha90wccurred. Thanks, @sha90w! (#505)
  • Ensure that labels generated by the conversion to MIR are always unique in a function. This didn’t lead to any known problems, but is generally good practice. (#507)

Crate

Breaking Changes

  • Fix soundness issue and incorrect behaviour of List::contains and List::index. These functions took their arguments by reference, but implementing the correct behaviour required that they take it by value. (#501)

Added

  • Added Blob::get_functions_by_signature to get all the functions in a Blob that match a given signature. Thanks, @algernon! (#494)
  • Make FunctionRetrievalError and TypeMismatch public. Thanks, @algernon! (#503)

Bug fixes

  • Fix DynVal being used in combination with vtables in the library! macro. Thanks, @sha90w! (#488)
  • Filter out generated functions from the hints generated by Blob::get_function. Thanks, @algernon! (#496)
  • Fix extracting tests from a Blob with tests in a dependency. (#499)
  • Fix a panic when displaying symbols that are not in a package, such as registered items. This panic was also triggered when such a symbol was used in the signature of an extracted function. (#497)

Documentation

  • The manual has a new look and has been improved in a few places. (#480)
